quarterly_data.quarter: Wacker Chemie press release: WACKER enters EU pet food additives market (08-13-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Wacker received European Commission approval, after a positive EFSA safety assessment, for its fermentation-based amino acids L-cystine and L-cysteine (FERMOPURE) as sensory feed additives for all animal species, opening the EU pet food market; Wacker has supplied pet food ingredients in the U.S. for more than ten years and calls itself the largest Western manufacturer of L-cysteine and L-cystine.
